title: Heterochronous multiplex real-time PCR with UNG and multiple primer pairs
author: Mizumoto-Teramura, Kamogashira, et al.

steps.title: First real-time PCR setup
steps.instruction: Prepare a real-time PCR reaction using either Gapdh pair 3 or Lpar1 pair 3 primers and run the PCR on the instrument according to its standard cycling conditions.

substeps.instruction: Prepare reaction mix with Gapdh pair 3 or Lpar1 pair 3 primers
Run real-time PCR using instrument’s standard program

steps.title: Purify first PCR products
steps.instruction: Recover the amplified DNA from the first PCR by applying a commercial PCR purification kit following the manufacturer’s protocol.

substeps.instruction: Use PCR purification kit according to manufacturer instructions

steps.title: UNG treatment of purified DNA
steps.instruction: Treat the purified DNA with uracil‑N‑glycosylase (UNG); select an appropriate UNG concentration (0.1 % was shown to be insufficient, so optimize as needed).

substeps.instruction: Add UNG to purified DNA at the chosen concentration

steps.title: Second real-time PCR setup
steps.instruction: Set up a second real-time PCR using the recovered DNA as template and either Gapdh pair 4 or Lpar1 pair 1 primers, then run the PCR under the instrument’s standard conditions.

substeps.instruction: Prepare reaction mix with Gapdh pair 4 or Lpar1 pair 1 primers
Run real-time PCR using instrument’s standard program

steps.title: Electrophoresis of PCR products
steps.instruction: Verify digestion of the PCR product by agarose gel electrophoresis.

substeps.instruction: Mix 5 µL of PCR product with 1 µL loading buffer
Prepare a 0.8 % agarose gel
Load the mixture and run at 100 V for 20 min
Capture the gel image with a transilluminator

steps.title: Analyze dissociation curves
steps.instruction: After the second real-time PCR, examine the dissociation (melting) curve; a single peak indicates complete digestion of the first‑round product.

substeps.instruction: Inspect the dissociation curve for a single peak

steps.title: Method validation: delta Ct comparison
steps.instruction: Confirm that UNG processing does not alter delta Ct (dCt) values by comparing results before and after treatment.

substeps.instruction: Perform the real‑time PCR on the same specimen before UNG processing
Perform the real‑time PCR on the same specimen after UNG processing
Calculate dCt values for Gapdh pair 4 and Lpar1 pair 4
Average dCt before UNG: 5.64 ± 0.11 (n = 3)
Average dCt after UNG: 5.21 ± 0.27 (n = 3)
Conduct an unpaired t‑test; two‑tailed P = 0.059

steps.title: Optimize UNG concentration (optional)
steps.instruction: Test UNG at 0.1 % concentration; if multiple peaks appear in the dissociation curve, increase UNG concentration and repeat until a single peak is obtained.

substeps.instruction: Treat purified DNA with 0.1 % UNG
Observe multiple peaks in the second‑PCR dissociation curve (indicating incomplete digestion)
Adjust UNG concentration upward and re‑check dissociation curves until a single peak is achieved
